bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Quarter-inch architectural scale (1/4 inch equals 1 foot) is a 1 to 48 reduction ratio, while 1/8 inch equals 1 foot is 1 to 96 scale.
core_mechanism_bullets: Quarter-inch architectural scale (1/4 inch equals 1 foot) is a 1 to 48 reduction ratio, while 1/8 inch equals 1 foot is 1 to 96 scale.
To convert full-size dimensions to model inches, divide real inches by the scale ratio, so 24 real feet at 1 to 48 equals 6.0 inches.
